doctrine: All non-Flaim planning/QA is locked before manual art production. PAGE_GENERATION_GATE combines pre-render preflight and candidate acceptance; only QA-passed output is APPROVED_FOR_LOCAL_FOLDER.

gates.enforcement: Official Flaim/ESPN decided state; populate deterministic result fields without reopening story.
Template/story/visual family locked now; only final settlement arithmetic remains.
Format and rules locked now; ranking values/movement recompute after Fact Lock.

gates.domain: State of the Realm Final Data
gates.enforcement: Narrative role and visual design locked; final divisional consequences populate after Fact Lock.
27-page Mission Review story lock controls. Final facts may surgically fill existing copy slots only.
Entering state, scene geography, permitted/non-permitted mutations and continuity objects are pre-cleared. Durable result-driven delta fields alone may fill after finality.
All 27 page story/character/world/composition/writing/rejection/mobile fields must exist before generation. Flaim-derived slots may remain placeholders only.

Single gate: pre-render preflight must pass, then candidate raster is inspected against the same packet; failed candidate is REJECTED_NOT_FOR_FOLDER; only passed candidate becomes APPROVED_FOR_LOCAL_FOLDER.
Mobile hierarchy, deterministic critical text, safe crop and text density are pre-cleared; final values fill after Fact Lock.
Restraint, tone, redundancy and page-purpose challenge run on the packet before art. No post-hoc story redesign.

gates.domain: Umpire Page Preflight + Final Assembly Audit
gates.enforcement: Umpire pre-clears each packet before art; later assembly audit checks 27 approved PNGs/order/duplicates/mobile PDF without reopening page stories.
Closer freezes all non-Flaim production decisions now. Final publication receipt later binds the compiled PDF.

closer_rule: Before art: all non-Flaim page decisions and QA criteria are frozen. After Flaim: populate deterministic slots only, then 'generate page N' invokes PAGE_GENERATION_GATE. No approved PNG enters Jake's local folder without candidate acceptance PASS.
rule: Exactly one named owner per gate; counterweights cannot be bypassed. Story/design/world/character decisions may not reopen merely because final scores arrive.
